answer.item: Mahito was born from the hate and fear humans have for each other.

questions.question: What did Mahito promise Kokichi Muta in their binding vow?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito enacted a binding vow with Kokichi Muta, in which Mahito would heal Kokichi. In return, Kokichi would act as mole within Jujutsu High and supply them with information.

questions.question: What did Mahito agree to with Geto at Dagon's domain?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito agrees with Geto, about sealing Satoru Gojo on a set date that he will contact them with.

questions.question: What did Mahito realize about Yuji's punch after Junpei died?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito notices that there is something different about that punch and realizes that Yuji can naturally injure him.

questions.question: What did Sukuna do when Mahito tried to force Yuji to switch with him?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Sukuna forces Mahito out of his innate domain and tells him there won't be another chance.

questions.question: What did Mahito obtain during the Kyoto Goodwill Event?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito manages to obtain the fingers, along with three of the Death Painting Wombs.

questions.question: What did Mahito do with the Death Painting Wombs at the start of the Death Painting Arc?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito feeds the Death Painting Wombs to humans, in order to give them bodies.

questions.question: How did Gojo stun Mahito and the other curses during the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito is then stunned after Gojo activates his Domain Expansion for less then a second. Leaving all the curses and transfigured humans stunned for several minutes.

questions.question: What did Pseudo-Geto do to Mahito at the end of the Shibuya Incident?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Pseudo-Geto uses his vessel's Cursed Spirit Manipulation technique to seal and absorb Mahito.

questions.question: What did Mahito deduce about Sukuna's true motives in the afterlife?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: Mahito deduced that Sukuna in truth wanted revenge throughout his life for being scorned and hated, to which the latter does not deny but claimed was of no difference.

questions.question: What did Yuji do with Mahito after their duel in the passageway of souls?
questions.subject: Mahito/Synopsis

answer.item: After grabbing a cut off piece of his face, Yuji mocks Mahito for his weakness and hands him to Maru, who proceeds to transform his remains into a doll to use for the ritual of harmony.
